events.title: Bumper & Thumper Demo is now live!
events.summary: After a lot of work, the first public demo of Bumper & Thumper is finally available! Jump behind the wheel, smash through hordes of robots, collect upgrades and combine weapons, charms and parts to turn your car into an unstoppable machine. Every car offers a different way to play and every run gives you new opportunities to experiment with builds and create increasingly ridiculous combinations. events.title: Bumper & Thumper Playtest is live!
events.summary: I've got some news! Playtest for Bumper & Thumper is now open.If a mash-up of vehicular combat roguelite mechanics with cars sounds like your kind of thing, I'd love for you to jump in and try it out.Hit Request Access on the store page and once you're in, let me know what works, what doesn't and what you'd change. Your feedback shapes where this game goes next. (Mostly, you know.)Huge thanks to everyone taking time to play, can't wait to hear what you think.
